title: Meromorphic solutions of first-order differential equations with rational exponential coefficients
summary: We study first-order differential equations $f'=R(e^z,f)$, where $R\in\C(t,w)$. We prove that a meromorphic solution on the whole complex plane is algebraic over $\C(e^z)$ unless $R$ is a polynomial of degree at most two in its second variable. Such an algebraic solution necessarily has the form $S(e^{z/q})$, with $S$ rational and $q$ a positive integer, giving an affirmative answer to Question~6.2 in Gundersen's collection.
